Alchemist.base: You drink potions 25% faster and have a 25% chance to not consume a potion ingredient.
Alchemist.aced: You now drink potions 70% faster and have a 50% chance to not consume a potion.

Deception.base: Dodging an attack also triggers any effects that would have occurred had you parried it instead. Yes, you can parry enemies with rolls.
Deception.aced: Parrying an attack also triggers any effects had you dodged it instead.

Stoic.aced: You can drink potions while you have potion sickness (as long as it's shorter than 30 seconds), but it will take much longer to drink.

Athlete.base: You reach max running speed 50% faster and your max running speed is increased by 10%.
Athlete.aced: Your roll cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Slippery.base: The movement speed reduction from attacking or being stunned is reduced by 35%.
Slippery.aced: Dodging an attack with a roll or dive will reset your roll cooldown.

Juggernaut.base: Being in combat will grant 10% damage reduction, but 10% lower speed and enemies target you.
Juggernaut.aced: Gain an additional 10% damage reduction and 10% increased damage during this but another 10% decrease to movement speed.

Tenacity.base: You can survive one hit with 1 HP left and debuffs cleared. This can only occur every 5 minutes.
Tenacity.aced: You now gain 25% increased regeneration for 5 seconds when this occurs. The cooldown is now 3 minutes.

Vexation.base: Max health is decreased by 50%, non-natural healing reduced by 25%, but you gain 25% damage reduction.
Vexation.aced: Damage is now reduced by 50% and non-natural healing reduced by 20%.

Bolster.base: Parrying no longer stops you from blocking. In addition, as long as you are blocking you will parry one attack. This has a 4 second cooldown.
Bolster.aced: You will still take some damage while blocking, but it will count as a parry.

Resilient.base: Taking damage grants you a stacking 10% damage resistance up to 50% for 2 seconds.
Resilient.aced: This effect now lasts 3 seconds and you gain super armor when you take damage.

Rally.base: Parrying an attack increases your mana regeneration by 25% for 3 seconds.
Rally.aced: Parrying an attack restores 6% of HP over 2 seconds.

Focus.base: Being stunned will no longer stop you from rolling.
Focus.aced: Being stunned will no longer stop you from blocking or parrying.

Unfettered.base: Any status effect that reduces your speed only affects you half as much as usual.
Unfettered.aced: You are stunned for 30% less time.

Perception.base: Ineffective elemental attacks now deal full damage.
Perception.aced: Effective elemental attacks are now +20% more effective.

Archery.base: Hit a target within 1.5 seconds of fully charging your bow to boost crit chance. This bonus stacks up to 25%, but is lost if you do not hit a target on time.
Archery.aced: This bonus now decreases charge time by up to 50% and no longer dissipates entirely upon failure.

Delicate.base: You gain 2% crit chance for every defense point below 10, up to 20%.
Delicate.aced: You gain 1% increased crit damage for every defense point below 10, up to 15%.

Wizardry.base: Being very close to an enemy increases mana gained by up to 25%.
Wizardry.aced: The range is increased by 50% and the boost is now increased up to 40%.

Bloodthirst.base: Every melee hit you land builds up stacks of bloodthirst. At 25 stacks, go into a frenzy for 2 seconds, boosting swing speed by 50% and removing any endlag.
Bloodthirst.aced: Bloodthirst frenzy lasts 3 seconds longer, but so does the cooldown.

Rampage.base: Killing an enemy grants you 1 stack of Rampage (6% more damage) for 10 seconds. Rampage is capped at 5 stacks.
Rampage.aced: Deal 50% more damage to enemies with less than 75% of your max health.

Rude.base: Grants a 4% up to 16% damage buff for every enemy within 50 studs.
Rude.aced: Now grants a 6% up to 42% damage buff for every enemy within 75 studs.

Sharpshooter.base: Standing still slowly increases your ranged weapons' ranges by up to 75% and crit chance by 10% after 1.5 seconds of not moving.
Sharpshooter.aced: This effect now maxes out by 1 second and now increases ranged damage by up to 25%.

Chicanery.base: Your bullets shoot a weaker bullet towards another enemy when hitting an enemy or a wall.
Chicanery.aced: It's now a 100% chance to shoot and it can ricochet many more times.

Tricky.base: Rolling gives you Tricky Roll for 1 second that is consumed when you attack. Tricky Roll reduces gun startup time by 50% or increases melee swing speed by 20%. This has a 3 second cooldown when used with melee weapons.
Tricky.aced: Tricky Roll now reduces gun startup time by 75% or increases melee swing speed by 40% and also reduces gun cooldown by 50%. And also the melee cooldown is now 2 seconds. Whew.

Ineffable.base: Mana cost is reduced by 20% when above 80% mana.
Ineffable.aced: Mana cost is reduced by 50% when below 20% mana.

Fearmonger.base: Taking damage causes enemies you hit to be fearful (enemies take 10% more damage and do 10% less damage) for 5 seconds.
Fearmonger.aced: Fear's effects are twice as effective.

Charger.base: 25% increased bow charge speed. Gain up to 20% boon in effective range based on arrow charge.
Charger.aced: Charging now has a sweet spot to fire that grants 20% more effective range and 30% more piercing. Firing outside of the sweet spot significantly dulls charge strength.
